backstory:
Giuseppi was born a very ugly child. Yet, somehow he has this notion that he is incredibly attractive. Every single time without fail when he passes a reflective surface he takes the opportunity to marvel at his “beautiful” face. Perhaps it’s because he was always congratulated by his mother no matter what he did, or it could be due to the fact that he is so beautiful but Giuseppi is an incredibly prideful man. Another reason Giuseppi’s is so prideful is because he has always been popular with both women and men throughout his whole life. 

Giuseppi Pesci Sr. is a man willing to do whatever it takes to accomplish his goals; Seduce women, cheat in a gambling match, murder a man, lie, steal, commit arson, …. 

Mateo Pesci (his father), is a banker who ,unfortunately, was harassed constantly by low level Jemand family members who wanted to make a quick buck, Killing two birds with one stone, Giuseppi convinced his father he could take care of the problem if he was given a large amount of gold. Using this gold, Giuseppi bought his way into the Jemand family. As someone who holds grudges, Giuseppi’s first order of business was to convince his boss to send those grunts that harassed his father on a suicide mission. None of them returned.

Around the age of 16, Giuseppi met a strange homeless man with a little dog roaming through the garbage of Luigi’s. He took him inside and bought him a family meal using his allowance. Dennis Stu, the homeless man ate to his heart’s content, thanked Giuseppi, then left. It was only after Giuseppi arrived home that he realized Dennis stole his wallet, he didn’t even realize Dennis had touched him in that whole meeting. The next day, Giuseppi wandered through town asking around about Dennis Stu, looking for the homeless man with violence on his mind. Everyone knew Dennis, he was a friendly hobo beloved by all. He used to be a good samaritan helping out many people in town, but he was kicked in the head by a donkey and was never quite right after. Upon hearing many different stories about how much people pitied Dennis, Giuseppi came up with a plan. He would pay for Dennis’s meals (to look like a better samaritan) and in exchange Dennis would teach him how to properly pickpocket/ cheat in gambling/ … Anything that required fast hands and good technique.  It wasn’t hard to find him, he was in another dumpster looking for food. Turns out, Dennis was a master Thief and grifter. Turns out, Dennis wasn’t actually kicked in the head by a Donkey, he just wanted to get out of a life of crime and thought this was the best method, by pretending to be brain damaged. So, he took up Giuseppi’s deal and trained him for over a year all the while feasting on Luigi’s pizza daily.

Around the age of 25, Giuseppi met Alessandra, his wife. She was a foreigner new to the area walking around town looking for a place to eat. Obviously, he took her to Luigi’s and it was her first time eating pizza, but she loved it. This first date going so well, is one of the reasons why Giuseppi loves Luigi’s and goes out of his way to get it to succeed. His family loves it so much, they typically eat it once a week. Alessandra was wary at first. But after months of generous acts and hearing about his excellent character from around town, she fell in love with Giuseppi and married him after 2 years of dating.

At the age of 27, Giuseppi married his wife, at the age of 28 she gave birth to their only child Giuseppi Pesci Jr. The joy of their life. Jr. was somewhat frail and unathletic causing him to spend most of his time indoors reading and studying. One day after work, Giuseppi saw smoke in Jr.’s room. Fearing the worst, he rushed into Jr’s room to save him. Turns out, Giuseppi was practicing magic and had started a small fire with only his voice and fingers. After this, Giuseppi was very supportive of Jr’s magical potential and bought him plenty of books to self-study. Since he only wants the best for his son, Giuseppi took years to vet potential magic teachers for his son, until he finally found one Céline Badeaux. A starving girl living in a shack in the middle of the woods. Killing two birds with one stone, Giuseppi realized he could be viewed in a more positive light in his neighborhood, if he helped take care of her and she could teach Jr magic. Thus began Jr’s magical training.

Giuseppi is a neighborhood man, he won’t cause issues for anyone in his neighborhood that could potentially spend time with his family. He wants to avoid any reason for someone to want to target his family for any reason. He is begrudgingly friendly with everyone in his neighborhood and anyone that is associated with his family in any regard. He views maintaining most of these relationships as a necessary evil. No one wants to help old lady Carol shovel snow from her house, but she makes cookies that Jr. loves. Sometimes Alessandra doesn’t want to cook dinner, so he treats Luigi as a solid family friend. He treats him so well, he has convinced Luigi to give the Jemand family a 25% discount, leading to a massive increase in customers for Luigi.


A few trusted individuals know about his real job as a Jemand hitman, but most people in the neighborhood see him as a sociable family man and an amazing father. A truly good samaritan who goes out of his way to help out people that are good to his family. 

Lives on  West Harbor & 5th Street.

Bogart is the pet toad of Jr., named after the infamous wizard (and book writer) Ripley Bogart.

Personality:
Keeps Grudges
Prideful
Agoraphobic
Massive Gambler
Always looks at himself in any reflective source
Must always be looking his best
Incredibly Ugly but sees himself as one of the most handsome men around
Really shitty at things he’s not good at (but doesn’t believe this is the case)
Surprisingly Cautious
Motto: Dress for Success
Always on edge
